topic: Released 0.45.0: password field focused on open (one-shot retry on first window event)
content: Today: init focus ran pre-layout and was dropped; added login_focus_pending + window-event subscription retry (Opened/Resized/Focused), re-armed on sign-out; no wire change; tag v0.45.0 CI green (pin c261d6b), host 0.45.0. Next: user relaunches GUI; Theming Apply pending for dialog colours.

topic: Released 0.46.0: nix update check parallel + git ls-remote for github refs (~1 s on host), same proof rule
content: Today: old check = sequential nix flake metadata per unique ref (fetch+eval, channel tarballs heavy); new = alias resolution via registry, parallel bounded 4, git ls-remote for github targets with rev pins, narHash fallback; list_nix_updates user-scoped; measured 1.39/0.95 s, 14 updates; tag v0.46.0 CI green (pin cb46c1e), host 0.46.0.

topic: Released 0.47.0: nix auto-check default on; refresh_apk removed (protocol v7); package-manager audit clean
content: Today: flipped UpdatesAuto.nix default on (verified config get_config apk/flatpak/nix true), audited every package-manager action (nix 18, apk 13, flatpak 14 - all GUI+CLI, jobs for mutations), removed the orphan refresh_apk and bumped protocol to 7; tag v0.47.0 CI green (pin 8091752), host 0.47.0.
